description: Skelet G09b-05 kit manifest assembler with rights firewall

compatibility.instructions: Could the kit-manifest module, its test file, or the CI lens-list addition regress any existing lens contract, frozen G09b-01 schema semantic, validator rule, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any wrong schema_version/lens_report/capture_scope mapping, missing required export, accepted illegal path or kind, trusted redistributable flag, wrong partition split, report-binding mismatch accepted, or test/implementation mismatch?

evidence.instructions: Are the 10 unit tests sufficient for valid assembly, rights firewall, partition order, binding equality, missing exports, path firewall, duplicates, page/scope/status violations, provenance violations, and malformed partition input?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic ordering, unhandled input shape, unbounded string, or detail leak across equivalent inputs?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond manifest assembly and partition: ZIP packaging, starter generation, storage, job lifecycle, network, or public API?

security.instructions: Any path traversal into the manifest, redistributable laundering for non-permitted bytes, silent artifact drop, fabricated hash, or secret material in the module or tests?
